name: Merutomo! Himitsu no Site e Youkoso
original_name: めるとも！ ヒミツのサイトへようこそ
source:
Main character receives wrong email and overcome with curiosity heads to the meeting place written in the email. There he learns the address of the site where girls who secretly like molesting gather. He is eager to satisfy the desires that can not be spoken outloud.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角誤收了一封電子郵件，按捺不住好奇心，前往郵件中寫明的見面地點。在那裡，他得知了一個秘密網站的網址，聚集於此的少女都暗中喜愛痴漢行徑。他迫不及待地想滿足那些無法公然說出口的慾望。
